function.name: DPA_EnumCallback
function.signature: VOID WINAPI DPA_EnumCallback (HDPA hdpa, PFNDPAENUMCALLBACK enumProc, LPVOID lParam)
function.header_comment:
/**************************************************************************
 * DPA_EnumCallback [COMCTL32.385]
 *
 * Enumerates all items in a dynamic pointer array.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *     hdpa     [I] handle to the dynamic pointer array
 *     enumProc [I]
 *     lParam   [I]
 *
 * RETURNS
 *     none
 */
